tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i kha skong gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad 'od kyi snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs// sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i kha skong gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad 'od kyi snang ba zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams dang lhag pa'i lha mchog mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan lhun grub gzhi nas chos kyi dbyings/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma sel bar byed pa'i lam/ /gnas gyur bral dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras/ /dbyer med snying po de la gus btud nas/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang tshad ldan gzhung lugs dang / /'khrul zad dam pa'i man ngag la brten nas/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal byed snang ba 'di/ /gzur gnas gzhan la phan phyir brtse bas bshad/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal shel gyi khams/ /bag chags tshon gyis bsgyur ba las/ /gnas skabs du mar snang ba yi/ /dbyings nyid 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi/ /theg gsum bslab pa lcags zangs dngul/ /rig 'dzin rtsi yis gsang chen gyi/ /gser du bsgyur ba'i nyams len ni/ /dri ma sel byed lam gyi mchog /gnas gyur nam mkhar bral 'bras kyi/ /yon tan zla ba shar ba las/ /gdul bya dag pa'i chu gtsang du/ /gzugs sku 'char ba 'bras bu 'o/ /gzhi la grub mtha'i bye brag gis/ /sems byung zag med sa bon dang / /skye mched drug gi khyad par sogs/ /'dod pa yod kyang 'dus byas yin/ /'dir ni byams mgon klu sgrub kyis/ /gsal ba rgyun chags ma 'gags pa/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros pas stong pa yi/ /zung 'jug 'dus ma byas la bzhed/ /de yang theg chen rgyud bla mar/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan gyi/ /ldog pa ma lus tshang ba ni/ /sgrub byed gsum gyis yod par bsgrub/ /rnam gzhag bcu yis gtan la dbab/ /dri mas sgrib tshul dpe dgus bstan/ /byang chub yon tan phrin las kyis/

/'bras bu'i gnas tshul khyad par bshad/ /klu sgrub zhabs kyi rigs tshogs las/ /rten 'brel mtha' bzhi'i spros pa yis/ /stong tshul rigs pas gtan phab nas/ /stong nyid bya byed rung bar gsungs/ /bstod pa'i tshogs las stong nyid de'ang / /ci yang med tsam yin spangs nas/ /'khor 'das lhun grub sems nyid kyi/ /yin phyir bya byed rung bar gsungs/ /des na theg chen dbu ma yi/ /lugs kyi gzhi yi 'dod tshul la/ /rgyal tshab rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i/ /srol 'byed 'di gnyis dgongs pa mthun/ /chos dbyings dri bcas de bzhin nyid/ /'od gsal bde gshegs snying po dang / /sems kyi rang bzhin dag pa sogs/ /mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas bstan/ /lang gshegs stug po bkod pa dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug man ngag dang / /dpal ldan zla ba'i zhabs sogs kyis/ /kun gzhi'i sgra yang 'di la bzhed/ /zab mo'i rgyud du 'jam dpal dang / /ye shes chen po lhan skyes dang / /rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa' dpal/ /kun bzang la sogs bgrang yas gsung / /deng sang tshig tsam smra ba la/ /ngo mtshar 'dzin pa'i mkhas rlom 'ga'/ /dri bcas sems la rigs pa yis/ /bden pa bkag tsam snying por 'dod/ /'di nyid thogs bcas bsal ba la/ /nam mkha' zhes ni btags pa dang / /mgo bor 'bigs nus bsal ba la/ /rwa med ces ni btags pa ltar/ /rtog pas dgag bya bcad tsam gyis/ /gzhan sel yin phyir gnas lugs kyang / /min na rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / /bde gshegs snying por ga la 'thad/ /'di la 'khor ba ji ltar tshang / /'di la lam nyid ji ltar bsgom/ /'di la 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung / /ngan rtog dra ba 'di dor cig /kha cig sems kyi stong gsal gnyis/ /'dus ma byas dang 'dus byas kyi/ /rang bzhin gnas rigs so sor bzhed/ /'di yang re zhig brtag par bya/ /zung 'jug sgrub phyir gnas skabs su/ /'khyog po bsrang ba'i tshul yin na/ /'gal ba med de zung 'jug la/

/ya gyal gnyis po dgos phyir ro/ /gzhan du nges pa'i don yin na/ /rang bzhin gnas rigs 'dus byas su/ /'dod pa dngos smra'i lugs yin gyi/ /dbu ma pa yi lugs la med/ /'ga' zhig chos ni thams cad kyi/ /snying po rang rang la yod phyir/ /bde gshegs snying po bde gshegs la/ /yod kyi 'gro ba'i rgyud la med/ /'gro la yod par gsungs pa ni/ /bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ /chos gsum sgo nas drang don du/ /gtan la dbab ces sgro 'dogs byed/ /'di ni 'jig rten bstan bcos kyi/ /tha snyad gnyis las 'das pa ste/ /sbrul gyi snying po sbrul nyid dang / /mar gyi snying po mar nyid la/ /yod phyir tsan+dan sbrul snying dang / /mar ni 'o ma'i snying po sogs/ /'jig rten kun la grags pa yi/ /tha snyad kun dang 'gal phyir dang / /dri med bka' dang bstan bcos las/ /bde gshegs snying po 'gro kun khyab/ /lus can sangs rgyas snying po can/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal phyir ro/ /de nyid drang don yin snyam na/ /bden gnyis sgo nas drang nges kyi/ /rnam gzhag byed tshe drang don kun/ /tha snyad du yang med na ni/ /phung po khams dang skye mched sogs/ /kun rdzob bden pa'i rnam gzhag kun/ /tha snyad du yang med 'gyur te/ /de dag drang don yin phyir ro/ /'jam dbyangs dgongs par 'dod na ni/ /des na de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /snying po spros bral yin pa'i phyir/ /sems can rnams la sangs rgyas dang / /'khor ba gnyis ka 'byung ba 'thad/ /ces gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /sems ni rang gnas snyeg pa'i phyir/ /me yi sgrub byed tsha ba ltar/ /bde gshegs khams kyi sgrub byed 'thad/ /ces gsungs pa dang cis mi 'gal/ /gzhan yang bem po'i chos dbyings dang / /sems can sems kyi chos dbyings gnyis/ /snying po yin par khyad med de/ /chos dbyings dbye ba med phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas kyang gnod pa ste/ /sems can sems kyi chos dbyings dang /

/sangs rgyas sems kyi chos dbyings gnyis/ /snying po yin par khyad med de/ /chos dbyings dbye ba med phyir ro/ /zhes pa kun tu mi mtshungs sam/ /rang gi ngan rtog khwa ta yis/ /lta ngan mi gtsang zos pa'i mchu/ /'jam dbyangs gzhung bzang pad+mo'i tshal/ /dri zhim ldan la bsgo ba mtshar/ /des na gzhung lugs chen po yi/ /dgongs pa kho bos tshul bzhin bshad/ /phrag dog phyogs 'dzin yid dor la/ /gzu bor gnas pa'i blo yis dpyod/ /chos dbyings bde gshegs snying po dang / /stong nyid la sogs rnam grangs ni/ /don dam bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ /nges don yin gyi drang don min/ /'on kyang dpe dgus bstan pa ltar/ /de nyid 'gro ba'i rgyud la ni/ /rten dang brten pa'i tshul gyis sam/ /sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa ni/ /drang don yin gyi nges don min/ /kun rdzob bden pa yin phyir ro/ /dgongs gzhi mtha' bzhi spros bral dang / /dgos pa skyon lnga spong ba yang / /sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa 'thad/ /de nyid nges pa'i don yin na/ /mu stegs bdag dang mtshungs pa sogs/ /dngos la gnod byed skyon rnams 'byung / /'di nyid theg chen rgyud bla las/ /'gro ba'i sems rgyud bdag gnyis kyi/ /spros pa zhi bar mthong ba la/ /ji ltar mthong bar gsungs pa dang / /spros bral chos nyid de nyid kyang / /sems can thams cad la yod par/ /mthong la ji snyed mthong bar ni/ /gsungs pa rtogs na 'bad med 'grub/ /kha cig rang bzhin rnam dag dang / /glo bur dri bral chos dbyings gnyis/ /phan tshun spangs te gnas pa'i phyir/ /glo bur dri bral chos dbyings ni/ /rang bzhin rnam dag min zhes thos/ /de smra kha yi bu ga ni/ /bu ga don med gzhan dang mtshungs/ /gang phyir dri ma bden grub kyis/ /dag pa'i dbyings dang glo bur gyi/ /dri ma gnyen pos bcom pa yi/ /dbyings kyi gzhi mthun med pa'i tshig /'byung ba'i bu ga yin phyir ro/

/dag cha gnyis po 'gal ba'i phyir/ /dag pa gnyis po 'gal snyam na/ /skyes dang 'jig pa'i cha 'gal phyir/ /byas dang mi rtag 'gal bar 'gyur/ /dag pa dang po mngon gyur tshe/ /gnyis pa mtha' dag mngon 'gyur te/ /gnyis pa dang po yin phyir ro/ /snyam na tshig gi sgrib g.yogs te/ /bdag med dang po mngon gyur tshe/ /gnyis pa mtha' dag mngon 'gyur te/ /gnyis pa dang po yin pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs kun tu mtshungs phyir ro/ /des na 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis/ /chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa las/ /gang zhig kun tu ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor ba/ /sems can rnams la nges gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /de nyid sbyang ba byas pa las/ /dag pa de nyid mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi sku yang de nyid do/ /zhes gsungs sngon gyi mkhas rnams kyang / /chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag la/ /glo bur dri ma dang bral ba'i/ /dag pa gnyis ldan zhes gsungs pa/ /tshad mar byas nas chos dbyings kun/ /rang bzhin rnam dag shes par gyis/ /mkhyen rab gshog yangs rgyas pa yis/ /gsung rab mkha' la bgrod gyur kyang / /rnam rig bag chags kyis bsgribs pa'i/ /skyes chen 'ga' zhig 'di skad gsungs/ /shes bya kun la bden gnyis dang / /mtshan nyid gsum du phye ba las/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang kun rdzob ste/ /yongs grub don dam bden pa 'o/ /chos rnams kun gyi don dam ni/ /sangs rgyas yin par khyad med phyir/ /sems can kun la sangs rgyas nyid/ /yod kyi sems can sangs rgyas med/ /don dam chos sku rang 'khrungs ni/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pas thob mi dgos/ /kun rdzob tshogs gnyis bsags pa yis/ /kun rdzob gzugs sku thob par 'dod/ /don dam kun rdzob chos kyis stong / /rang gi ngo bos mi stong ste/ /rtag brtan ther zug bden grub phyir/ /kun rdzob rang gi ngo bos stong / /don dam 'di ni gzhi dus dang /

/'bras bu'i skabs su dri ma yis/ /dag dang ma dag ma gtogs pa/ /yon tan ldog pa khyad par med/ /'di ni bden pa'i gcig tu grub/ /stobs sogs chos sku'i yon tan dang / /gzugs sku'i yon tan mtshan dpe sogs/ /dam pa'i don du 'di la tshang / /dpal phreng myang 'das snying po'i mdo/ /sor phreng la phan lang gshegs dang / /dgongs 'grel la sogs nges don gyi/ /mdo sde'i dgongs pa 'di nyid de/ /byams pa'i gsung rab rnam lnga dang / /thogs med sku mched phyogs glang dang / /chos kyi grags pa'i gzhung lugs rnams/ /dbu ma chen po'i lugs yin pas/ /de dag dgongs pa'ang 'di nyid yin/ /klu sgrub yab sras kyang ni bzhed/ /zab mo'i rgyud sde thams cad kyi/ /dgongs pa phyogs gcig pa zhes smra/ /'di la sgro skur spangs nas ni/ /lung dang rigs pas dpyad par bya/ /gzhi 'bras kun tu dbyer med pa'i/ /chos dbyings bde gshegs snying po dang / /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /don dam sangs rgyas yin par ni/ /theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud kyi/ /dgongs pa yin par kho bo'ang 'dod/ /lhag ma tha snyad don dam pa/ /gnyis dang 'gal ba 'di ltar mthong / /tha snyad sgo nas gsung rab don/ /'chad tshe dri mas ma dag pa'i/ /chos dbyings sangs rgyas yin smra ba/ /tha snyad nyid dang 'gal ba ste/ /tha snyad tshe na dman mnyam dang / /khyad 'phags yod med skye 'gag sogs/ /so sor phye nas smra dgos phyir/ /de skad du yang klu sgrub kyis/ /stong nyid bdun cu pa las ni/ /gnas pa'am skye 'jig yod med dam/ /dman pa'am mnyam dang khyad par can/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten bsnyad dbang gis/ /gsung gi yang dag dbang gis min/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs phyir ro/ /tha snyad tshe na de yin mod/ /de nyid tshad mar byed na ni/ /rton pa bzhi yi go rim rnams/ /log pa nyid du 'gyur zhe na/ /de yi go rim 'di ltar yin/ /thog mar tha snyad khas blangs nas/

/phyi nas dam pa'i gnas lugs la/ /'jug pa yin gyi tha snyad nyid/ /dang po nyid nas dor na ni/ /tha snyad don med 'gyur ba 'am/ /go rim log par khyod la 'gyur/ /de skad du yang rtsod zlog las/ /tha snyad khas ni ma blangs par/ /nged cag 'chad par mi byed do/ /zhes gsungs rtsa ba'i shes rab las/ /tha snyad la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs na/ /mya ngan 'das pa 'thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs zla ba grags pas kyang / /kun rdzob don dam thabs dang ni/ /thabs byung yin phyir de gnyis kyi/ /rnam dbye mi shes lam ngan lugs/ /gsungs pa'ang 'di nyid yin phyir ro/ /gal te tha snyad tshe na yang / /ma dag dbyings nyid sangs rgyas su/ /smra ba yin pas skyon med na/ /'di ni 'phags pa'i gzhung dang 'gal/ /ci slad ce na rgyud bla mar/ /ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin/ /sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa zhes brjod do/ /zhes gsungs chos dbyings bstod pa las/ ji ltar sos ka'i dus su chu/ /dro 'o zhes ni brjod par byed/ /de nyid grang ba'i dus su ni/ /grang ngo zhe ni brjod pa bzhin/ /nyon mongs drwa bas g.yogs pa na/ /sems can bya bar brjod pa yin/ /de nyid nyon mongs bral gyur na/ /sangs rgyas zhes ni brjod par byed/ /ces gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /ji ltar sbun pas g.yogs pa na/ /so ba 'bras bur mi 'dod ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis g.yogs pas/ /de ni sangs rgyas zhes mi brtag /ji ltar sbun pa las grol na/ /'bras nyid snang bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs bral gyur na/ /chos kyi sku yang rab tu gsal/ /zhes sogs tha snyad so sor gsungs/ /des na dpal ldan rtse mo yis/ /kye rdor zhes bya'i mtshan gyis ni/ /'bras rgyud dngos bstan rgyu dang lam/ /shugs las shes pa'i mthun pa'i dper/ /phyogs kyi glang pos sher phyin dngos/

/'bras bu sangs rgyas ye shes te/ /gzhung dang lam gnyis btags pa bar/ /gsungs pa bkod 'di gus pas longs/ /gal te 'di la'ang rgyud gsum ka /kye rdor nyid du bzhed ce na/ /rgyud kyi mtshan don 'chad pa'i tshe/ /brjod bya don gyi kye rdo rje/ /rgyud ni gsum char la 'jug kyang / /de nyid dngos btags phye ba'i tshe/ /he ni snying rje chen po nyid/ /badz+ra'ang shes rab brjod par bya/ /zhes pa'i don ni dngos yin la/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud/ /ces pa'i don ni tshang bas na/ /rgyu dang lam la'ang kye rdor sgra/ /'jug phyir de gsum 'chad pa la/ /kye rdor 'chad ces gsungs pa yi/ /don yin gzhan du rgyud gsum ka /kye rdor yin na de yi sgras/ /'bras rgyud dngos bstan rgyu dang lam/ /shugs las bstan pa mi 'thad de/ /gsum ka kye rdor yin phyir ro/ /dper na bum pa zhes pa'i sgras/ /gser bum dngos bstan dngul bum ni/ /shugs las bstan par mi 'thad bzhin/ /des na ha ri bha dra yis/ /dngos dang btags par gsungs pa dang / /dkon mchog 'bangs kyis gtso phal du/ /gsungs pa de gnyis don gcig ste/ /dngos btags gtso phal don gcig pa/ /gzhung lugs chen po'i lugs yin phyir/ /de skad du yang rnam 'grel las/ /ji ltar grags las grub gang yin/ /dngos dang de dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /gang la de skad brjod phal pa/ /dngos la dngos med btags phyir ro/ /zhes sogs du ma gsungs la ltos/ /gzhung lam sher phyin mtshan nyid par/ /'dod pa nges don rgya mtsho yi/ /dgongs pa nyid kyang ma yin te/ /der ni gzhi 'bras dbyer med pa'i/ /gnyis med ye shes mtshan nyid par/ /byas na gzhung dang lam gnyis la/ /btags pa bar ni gsungs phyir ro/ /'on kyang 'di yang mi 'thad de/ /gzhi dus gnyis su med ye shes/ /sher phyin yin na de bzhin gshegs/ /zhes pas rten gyi khyad par ni/ bstan pa don med 'gyur phyir ro/

/de nyid rnam grangs yin snyam na/ /gzhi dus de bzhin gshegs yod la/ /tha snyad dang 'gal sngar bstan zin/ /gzhan yang gzhung dang lam gnyis la/ /mtshan nyid gsum du phye ba yi/ /yongs grub sher phyin ma yin na/ /rang gi grub mtha' nyid dang 'gal/ /yin na 'di don bshad dang 'gal/ /des na gzhung de'i dgongs pa ni/ /'phags yul mkhas grub kun mthun par/ /sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma yis/ /tshul bzhin bshad pa gus pas longs/ /chos sku glo bur dri bral cha/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pas thob dgos na/ /don dam chos sku min par 'gyur/ /tshogs gnyis bsags la mi ltos na/ /'gro kun dang po nyid nas kyang / /glo bur dri ma bral 'gyur bas/ /snying po dri mas sgrib pa'i tshul/ /dpe dgus bstan pa don med 'gyur/ /don dam gnas lugs dang 'gal ba/ /'di ltar mthong ste chos kyi dbyings/ /yongs grub bden par grub pa ni/ /nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde dang / /klu sgrub dgongs pa ma yin te/ /mdo las zab zhi spros bral dang / /'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa lnga/ /rnam grangs nyid du gsungs phyir dang / /de nyid mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ /skye dang gnas dang 'jig pa dag /ma grub phyir na 'dus byas med/ /'dus byas rab tu ma grub pas/ /'dus ma byas ni ji ltar 'grub/ /ces gsungs 'di yi 'dus byas dang / /'dus ma byas gnyis bden med par/ /mtshungs pa nyid du bstan phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub kyis/ /dngos smra 'gog pa'i rigs pa rnams/ /rang la log pa nyid 'gyur te/ /bden grub chos ni dam bcas phyir/ /de skad du yang rtsod zlog las/ /gal te ngas dam bcas 'gal yod/ /des na nga la skyon de yod/ /nga la dam bca' med pas na/ /nga ni skyon med kho na yin/ /ces gsungs pa yi dam bca'i don/ /bden grub dam bca' nyid la ni/ /rang nyid kyang ni 'chad phyir ro/ /de la skyon spong 'di skad du/ /'dus ma byas ni ma grub dang /

/bden grub dam bca' med pa ni/ /mnyam gzhag la zlo'i skabs yin gyi/ /rjes thob shan 'byed skabs min phyir/ /nged la gnod pa med ces zer/ /gdul byas gnas lugs rtogs don du/ /rigs pas gtan 'bebs gnas skabs dang / /dbu ma pa yi skyes chen gyis/ /dngos smra'i rtsod pa zlog pa'i skabs/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i skabs yin gyi/ /rjes thob gnas skabs min no zhes/ /smra ba 'di la'ang bden 'dzin yod/ /rjes thob rtsod pa mi byed par/ /mnyam gzhag rtsod pa byed ces pa/ /rtsa ba'i grub mtha' shel sgong la/ /sgrub byed ltar snang tshon rnams kyis/ /re zhig nor bur kha bsgyur yang / /dngos stobs rigs pa'i chu gtsang dang / /phrad tshe rang mdog 'di ltar ston/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mdo las/ /chos rnams thams cad rnam kun tu/ /stong pa zhes ni gsungs pa dang / /'khor lo phyi mar sems can la/ /snying po yod par gsungs pa gnyis/ /'gal lo snyam du dogs pa'i lan/ /snga ma nges pa'i don yin zhing / /phyi ma skyon lnga spong phyir du/ /gsungs pas drang don nyid yin par/ /mgon po byams pas rgyud blar gsungs/ /des na drang don nges don gyi/ /mdo sde ma 'dres so sor smros/ /chos dbyings gnyis med ye shes sogs/ /bden par grub pa rgyud sde yi/ /dgongs pa nyid kyang ma yin te/ /rang rig ye shes mkha' mnyam dang / /rdul bral stong pa la sogs pa/ /bden grab log rtog bzlog phyir du/ /gcig dang du ma bral ba'ang de/ /zhes pa kye rdor rgyud las gsungs/ /byams chos phyi ma rnam gsum dang / /thogs med sku mched rang gzhung dang / /phyogs glang grags pa'i mdo dang ni/ /sde bdun la sogs gzhung lugs rnams/ /dbu ma chen po'i lugs yin na/ /'phags pa'i yul nas gangs can 'dir/ /sems tsam gzhung lugs ma 'gyur ram/ /'gyur na gang zhig yin par smros/ /bdag ni dpal ldan dus 'khor gyi/ /srol 'dzin nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa'i/

/skyes chen brgyud pa 'di dag la/ /yid ni shin tu dad mod kyi/ /'on kyang rgya bod kun mthun pa'i/ /lta ba spros bral sgrub pa'i phyir/ /sgro skur spangs nas 'di tsam zhig /rnam par dpyad pa drang por zung / /mdor na chos rnams sems su 'dus/ /sems nyid mtha' bzhi'i spros dang bral/ /de yang gsal la ma 'gags pa'i/ /brjod bral snying por shes par gyis/ /gzhi'i skabs te dang po'o// ༈ //lam la grub mtha' rnam bzhi yi/ /rang rang gzhung las theg gsum gyi/ /lam gyi rnam gzhag byed mod kyi/ /rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis/ /gong ma gong mas gnod pa'i tshe/ /dbu ma'i gzhung lugs ma rtogs par/ /theg gsum lam nyid tshang bar ni/ /med ces dbu ma pa rnams bzhed/ /pho rol phyin las ches 'phags pa'i/ /zab mo sngags kyi sgor zhugs tshe/ /sdom gsum ldan pas 'bras bu mchog /sgrub cing sdom gsum de nyid kyang / /rang rang cho gas rim bzhin du/ /blangs sam dbang bskur cho ga las/ /gsum char thob pa nyid kyang rung / /gsum ldan tshe na ngo bo gcig /de la kha cig so thar gyi/ /sdom pa gzugs can du 'dod cing / /grangs kyang rigs brgyad kho nar nges/ /'chi tshe gtong bas khyab par 'dod/ /mdo rgyud gzhung mang ma mthong bar/ /bye smra'i 'dul mngon mthong tsam gyis/ /khron pa'i sbal chung ji bzhin du/ /rang snang tsam gyis tshim par zad/ /bye smras sdom pa gzugs can du/ /'dod pa mdo sde'i mkhas rnams kyis/ /bkag na dbu sems gzhung bzang dang / /zab mo'i rgyud sder smos ci dgos/ /gzhan du rgyud rgyas 'bum pa las/ /rigs can gsum gyi bslab pa yang / /dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs na/ /rig 'dzin sdom par 'gyur zhes pa'i/ /lung gis dngos su gnod pa ste/ /bem po shes par 'gyur ba ni/ /rgyang 'phen pa yi lugs yin gyi/ /sangs rgyas gzhung las mi srid phyir/ /rigs brgyad kho nar nges na ni/ /nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa dang /

/byang sems so sor thar pa dang / /chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo rnams las/ /gsungs pa'i so sor thar pa rnams/ /brgyad po gang du 'dod pa smros/ /sngags sdom byang sems sdom pa yi/ /bye brag yin zhing de nyid kyang / /gzhan la phan pa bsgrub pa la/ /gzhan la gnod pa spong ba yis/ /khyab phyir so sor thar pa yi/ /don tshang gnyis po gang du 'dus/ /'on kyang rdo rje rtse mo las/ /gsungs pa'i khyim pa'i sdom pa dang / /sta gon 'jug pa'i gnas skabs su/ /thun mong min pa'i skyabs 'gro las/ /thob pa'i so thar sdom pa rnams/ /dge bsnyen sdom pa bla ma bzhed/ /'di la 'thad pa mang yod kyang / /gzhung mang dogs pas re zhig bzhag /des na ji skad bshad pa yi/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa rnams/ /byang chub bar du blangs pa'i phyir/ /shi 'phos tshe na ji ltar gtong / /la la so sor thar pa la/ /'jigs skyob legs smon nges 'byung gi /tshul khrims gsum du dbye bar 'dod/ /rgyu klu sgrub/ ngag dbang chos grags/ chos rnam pa sogs kyi bzhed pas/ dus kyi kun slong myang 'das kyi/ /zhes dang / rgyu yi kun slong sgo nas ni/ /zhes tshig bsgyur dgos pa'i sgrub byed mdzad kyang kha skong gi dpe phal cher na gong bzhin yod/ yi kun slong myang 'das kyi/ /bsam pas zin pas gsum char ni/ /so sor thar pa khyad med kyang / /dus kyi kun slong sgo nas ni/ /gsum po so sor dbye zhes zer/ /'o na phyi rol pa rnams la/ /'jigs skyob legs smon yod pa'i phyir/ /so thar sdom pa yod par 'gyur/ /'dod na phyi rol pa dag la/ /yang dag blangs pa'i tshul khrims ni/ /yod kyang srid pa la brten phyir/ /so sor thar pa med do zhes/ /mdzod kyi 'grel par gsungs dang 'gal/ /'jigs skyob dang ni legs smon gnyis/ /so sor thar pa ma yin te/ /srid pa la brten phyir zhes pa'i/ /skyon yang lung des gsal bar bstan/ /des na nges 'byung tshul khrims dang /

/so thar don gcig 'dul ba'i lugs/ /gal te skyabs 'gro'i dus kyi tshe/ /nges 'byung bsam pas khyab pa'i phyir/ /gnyis po'ang so thar yin snyam na/ /de yang bsgrub bya dang mtshungs te/ /skyabs 'gro nyid la 'jigs skyob dang / /legs smon skyabs 'gro yod phyir ro/ /gzhan yang 'di la lung rigs kyi/ /gnod byed char ltar 'bab na yang / /kun gyis nor bar go ba'i phyir/ /'dir ni re zhig mi spro 'o/ /kha cig so thar sdom pa yi/ /ngo bo gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas/ /spong bar 'phags yul gzhung 'grel las/ /bshad pa med ces sgrog pa thos/ /dpal ldan kha che blo brtan gyis/ /bye brag bshad pa las gsungs gang / /bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma rnams/ /spyi bo'i thod bzhin khur bar mdzad/ /la la gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas/ /spong ba dge slong sdom pa yi/ /ngo bo yin gyi so sor thar/ /spyi yi ngo bo min zhes smra/ /nged kyi lugs 'di blo brtan dang / /sa skya'i rje btsun yab sras dang / /dpang lo mchims ston nam mkha' grags/ /bu ston kha che la sogs kyis/ /mgrin gcig nyid du gsungs pa yin/ /khyed kyi lugs 'di khyed nyid las/ /gzhan pa'i rgya bod su zhig gis/ /bshad pa yod na khungs ston cig /'ga' zhig skyes tshogs kho na yis/ /deng sang bud med bsnyen rdzogs byed/ /dngos gzhi gsol bzhi'i las kyi tshe/ /tshogs gnyis phan tshun bsnor ba dang / /las tshigs phan tshun bsnor bas kyang / /'chags par las gzhi nyid las gsungs/ /'on kyang da lta'i cho ga yis/ /bud med bsnyen par rdzogs pa la/ /tshangs spyod nyer gnas ma song bar/ /bsnyen par rdzogs par mi 'gyur zhing / tshangs spyod nyer gnas ma tshogs ni/ /kho nas ster bar gzhung las gsungs/ /'di la dmigs bsal ma gsungs shing / /sgrub byed gzhan yang med pas na/ /'di 'dra'i cho ga byed pa ni/ bstan pa dkrugs pa'i snyad kar zad/ /de la kha cig tshigs snga ma/ /med par skye la nyes byas su/

/gsungs pas 'di nyid 'grub ces zer/ /tshangs spyod nyer gnas bslab tshigs su/ /'dod pa mkhas pa'i bzhad gad gnas/ /ci phyir zhe na bud med la/ /dge slob ma las ma gtogs pa'i/ /bslab tshigs lhag po ma gsungs phyir/ /bslab tshigs don yang mi gnas te/ /tshangs spyod nyer gnas thob nas ni/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa ma thob pa'i/ /bar der bslab mtshams med phyir ro/ /des na khyod las mkhyen brtse'i tshogs/ /che ba sngon gyi zhi 'tsho dang / /bar gyi bla chen mkhan brgyud dang / /tha mar paṇa chen shāka shrī sogs/ /bod yul 'dul ba'i srol 'byed rnams/ /ljongs 'dir bud med bsnyen par rdzogs/ /mdzad pa med pa 'di nyid la/ /bsams nas bstan pa ma dkrugs shig /la la bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub bya ni/ /gsum las mang bar mi rung yang / /rang byung dge tshul dag la ni/ /gsum las mang ba 'jug rung ste/ /tshogs kyis tshogs la mi chags par/ /gsungs pa las brgya rtsa gcig po/ /kho na'i dbang du byas phyir dang / /gnyis la de dag med ces zer/ /'o na dngos gzhi gsol bzhi las/ /ma gtog bsnyen rdzogs cho ga'i skabs/ /gzhan la'ang de dag rung 'gyur te/ /rgyu mtshan kun tu mtshungs phyir ro/ /'dul bar gsungs pa'i las la ni/ /brgya rtsa gcig tu ma nges te/ /rab byung zhu ba la sogs la'ang / /las su gzhung las gsungs phyir ro/ /'di ni rje btsun rtse mo dang / /dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ /nyan thos bstan pa nub gyur kyang / /gzugs brnyan tsam zhig snang ba'i dper/ /rab byung gang zag gsum las ni/ /mang ba mi 'jug bkod gyur kyang / /da ni 'di la'ang brgal bar snang / /kye ma bstan pa 'di ltar gyur/ /des na byang chub rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ /so thar nyams su len 'dod na/ /yang na nyan thos 'dul ba las/ /ji ltar gsungs pa nyams su longs/ /'di nyid theg chen sems bskyed kyis/ /zin na byang sems sdom par 'gyur/ /yang na theg pa chen po las/

/byung ba'i skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa la/ /byang chub bar du slab pa'i gzhi/ /lnga char 'dzin pa thob pa 'am/ /don zhags rtog pa nas bshad pa'i/ /nyin zhag gso sbyong nyams su longs/ /so so thar pa'i sdom pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// ༈ //byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni/ /pha rol phyin pa'i dbu sems kyi/ /srol chen gnyis las thob pa 'am/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde las gsungs pa'i/ /cho ga dag las thob kyang rung / /smon 'jug sems bskyed thob nas ni/ /tshul khrims bslab pa rnam pa gsum/ /bsrung ba nyams len dngos gzhi yin/ /de yi gtso bo spyod pa'i cha/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems dang / /lta ba mtha' bzhi'i spros bral gnyis/ /zung 'jug nyams su len pa yin/ /de la kha cig brje ba'i don/ /gces 'dzin brje ba nyid yin gyi/ /dge sdig bde sdug brje min te/ /brje bar mi nus phyir zhes zer/ /'o na gces 'dzin brje ba yang / /brje ba'i don nyid min 'gyur te/ /brje bar mi nus mtshungs phyir ro/ /dngos su brje bar mi nus kyang / /blo yi steng du sbyor zhe na/ /de ni ci gshos la mtshungs te/ /rang gzhan bde dang sdug bsngal gnyis/ /dngos su brje bar su yis nus/ /blo la bde sdug mi brje na/ /gces 'dzin brje ba 'gal ba ste/ /kha zas gzhan la ma byin par/ /rang gis zos pa ji bzhin no/ /dge sdig brje ba bkag pa ni/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub kyis/ /bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ces gsungs pa dang cis mi 'gal/ bde sdug brje ba bkag pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug las/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje ba ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi grub cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /ces gsungs pa dang cis mi 'gal/ /spyod 'jug lung don de nyid la/ /khyod kyi grub mtha' chos can du/ /bzung nas thal ba 'phen na ni/

/chos mthun lan nyid gang la 'debs/ /mdor na blo la 'dod mi 'dod/ /gnyis su phye ba'i 'dod pa kun/ /gzhan la ster zhing mi 'dod kun/ /rang la len par goms pa ni/ /mdo sde dbyug gsum phreng ba dang / /bstan bcos bslab btus spyod 'jug sogs/ /dgongs pa dpal ldan a ti shas/ /zab don nyams khrid sgo nas ni/ /bshes gnyen ston pa nyid la gnang / /phyi nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'phel/ /sangs rgyas bsgom pa la sogs kyi/ /bsgom tshul zhib tu bshad pa'ang mthong / /sa skya'i rje btsun mchog rnams la/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i/ /man ngag gnyis las 'di nyid kyi/ /nyams len gsal ba'i bka' babs bzhugs/ /de dang sngar gyi bka' srol gnyis/ /khyad par med pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa'i snying po yin pa'i phyir/ /mos pa tsam la'ang byin rlabs 'byung / /kha cig mtha' bzhi'i spros bral ni/ /rgya nag dge slong lta ba dang / /khyad par med phyir nor pa yin/ /rigs pas bden pa bkag rjes su/ /bden med nyid la zhen pa ni/ /dbu ma'i lta ba mthar thug ste/ /theg pa gsum char 'di nyid ni/ /rtogs phyir lta ba khyad par med/ /bden tshad de yang rang rgyud pas/ /blo la ma ltos yul ngos nas/ /grub pa nyid la 'dod gyur kyang / /de ni dgag bya thun mong ste/ /ming gis btags don btsal ba'i tshe/ /rnyed pa bden tshad du byas nas/ /de nyid 'gog pa thal 'gyur ba'i/ /thun mong ma yin khyad chos yin/ /dgag bya'i khyad par 'di rtogs na/ /blo yis gang du zhen pa'i yul/ /rigs pas dpyad nas 'gog pa yi/ /log rtog thams cad khegs par 'gyur/ /gzhan du bden pa bkag rjes su/ /bden med zhen pa'ang 'gog dgos na/ /blo yis snga ma gnod bcas dang / /phyi ma thug med nyid du 'gyur/ /bden par med pa 'gog na ni/ /bden par yod pa nyid 'gyur te/ /dgag pa gnyis kyi rnal ma ni/ /go ba'i phyir zhes 'dzer bar byed/ /lta ba'i snyems ma 'di dag ni/

/lung dang rigs pas dgag par bya/ /rgya nag dge slong ma dpyad par/ /rang dgar rtog pa bkag pa la/ /sgom gyi mchog tu smra ba dang / /'di ni rigs pas dpyad pa'i tshe/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros pa ma rnyed pa'i/ /'dzin med lta bar smra ba gnyis/ /mtshungs zhes smra ba stong pa nyid/ /zab mo spong ba'i bdud tshig yin/ /gzhan yang dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ /yod med gnyis po mtha' re re/ /byas nas dbus ni dbu ma ste/ /de yang bstan med brjod med par/ /gsungs pa de yang rgya nag gi /lta ba nyid dang khyad med 'gyur/ /de bzhin ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ /yod med gtsang dang mi gtsang sogs/ /mtha' gnyis yin phyir de spangs nas/ /dbus la'ang mi gnas gsungs pa dang / /yum las stong dang mi stong sogs/ /gnyis la spyod pa thams cad ni/ /mtshan mar spyod pa gsungs pa dang / /yang dag sbyor ba'i rgyud las kyang / /stong pa bsgom par mi bya ste/ /stong min bsgom par mi bya 'o/ /stong pa mi spong rnal 'byor pas/ /stong min yongs su mi spang ngo / /stong dang mi stong gzung ba la/ /rtog pa nyung min skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yang rgya nag gi /lta ba nyid dang khyad med 'gyur/ /mgon po byams pas rgyud bla mar/ /'gog bden yod dang med pa dang / /gnyis dang gnyis min rnam pa bzhir/ /brtag par mi nus gsungs pa dang / /dbu ma rtsa ba'i bstan bcos las/ /stong ngo zhes kyang mi brjod de/ /mi stong zhes kyang mi bya zhing / /gnyis dang gnyis min mi bya ste/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /bcom ldan bzhugs dang mya ngan las/ /'das pa gnyis la mtha' bzhi yi/ /spros pa bkag par mdzad pa dang / /rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po dang / /'phags pa lha yis 'di skad du/ /yod min med min yod med min/ /gnyis ka'i bdag nyid kyang min pa/ /mtha' bzhi las grol dbu ma pa/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis de kho na/ /zhes gsungs pa yang rgya nag gi /lta ba nyid dang khyad med 'gyur/

/de la yod min med min don/ /kun rdzob don dam la dgongs pas/ /nged la gnod pa med ces zer/ /'o na snang ba'i dngos po kun/ /don dam yod dang kun rdzob tu/ /med pa gnyis kar thal 'gyur te/ /gnyis ka min pa min pa'i phyir/ /rnam gsum khas blangs dran par gyis/ /kha cig yod med la sogs bzhi/ /bden par med pa'i don yin zer/ /bzhi po chos can du bzung nas/ /bden pa bkag pa sgrub chos su/ /yab sras gzhung las ma gsungs te/ /thams cad bcom ldan gshegs bzhugs dang / /gnyis med ye shes la sogs la/ /bzhi po bkag par gsungs phyir ro/ /bden pa bkag pa'i med dgag la/ /dbu ma'i lta bar zhen pa ni/ /sngar bshad yid ches lung gis gnod/ /rgyud las rtsa ba'i ltung bar gsungs/ /theg gsum lta ba khyad med na/ /mi pham mgon pos theg gsum la/ /bdag med rtogs pa rim gsum dang / /theg chen sbyor mthong bsgom pa gsum/ /dman pa'i sbyor mthong bsgom gsum las/ /lta bas 'phags tshul gsung dang 'gal/ /klu sgrub zhabs kyis mtshan med ni/ /tshang bar rtogs dang ma rtogs pa'i/ /khyad par gsungs shing zla bas kyang / /'khor gsum mi dmigs shes rab dang / /bsam gyis mi khyab chos nyid sogs/ /lta ba'i khyad par gsung dang 'gal/ /rigs pas kyang ni gnod pa ste/ /dman pa'i mthong ba'i lam nyid nas/ /bde gshegs snying po mthong bar 'gyur/ /'dod na las nyon las byung ba'i/ /skye sogs rnams las 'das 'gyur zhing / /nyan rang snying po lta ba la/ /mig dang mi ldan gang zag tu/ /thogs med zhabs kyis gsung dang 'gal/ /blo la ma ltos yul ngos nas/ /grub pa rang rgyud kun 'gog na/ /bha byas phyi don rang ngos nas/ /grub par khas blangs smras dang 'gal/ /btags don btsal tshe ma rnyed don/ /tha snyad don dam gang du 'dod/ /tha snyad yin na 'dogs byed kyi/ /ming yang tha snyad med 'gyur te/ /de dag phan tshun ltos grub phyir/ /de skad du yang dbu ma las/

/byed po las la brten byas shing / /las kyang byed po de nyid la/ /brten nas 'byung bar ma rtog par/ /'grub pa'i rgyu ni ma mthong ngo / /byed pa po dang las dbang gis/ /dngos po lhag ma shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs dngos po lhag ma ni/ /brjod bya rjod byed la sogs pa/ /ltos grub kun la 'jug par gsungs/ /dam pa'i don du ma rnyed pa/ /de don yin na chos thams cad/ /dam pa'i don du mi rnyed par/ /thal rang gnyis ka mthun pa'i phyir/ /gcig gi khyad chos ji ltar 'gyur/ /blo yis gang du zhen pa'i yul/ /rigs pas dpyad nas 'gog pa ni/ /log rtog yin na sangs rgyas nas/ /bzung ste rgya bod mkhas grub kun/ /log rtog de dang ldan gyur te/ /de dag stong dang mi stong sogs/ /gnyis 'dzin zhen yul bkag phyir ro/ /gcig dang du bral gtan tshigs kyis/ /rtog blos zhen yul bden grub pa/ /'gog na khyod kyi dam bca' nyams/ /mi 'gog na ni bden 'dzin gyi/ /log rtog gang gis khegs par 'gyur/ /ci srid rtog blos yul gyi ni/ /gnas lugs dpyod par byed pa'i tshe/ /snga phyi gnod bcas thug med gnyis/ /'dod thog yin na gang gis gnod/ /'di la gnod byed gang brjod pa/ /dbu ma rtsa ba'i bstan bcos las/ /bdag go zhes kyang btags 'gyur zhing / /bdag med ces kyang bstan par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag dang ni/ /bdag med 'ga' med ces kyang bstan/ /ces gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /thams cad yang dag yang dag min/ /yang dag yang dag ma yin nyid/ /yang dag min min yang dag min/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rjes bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa la cis mi gnod/ /'on kyang 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ngor/ /spros pa thams cad nyer zhi'i tshe/ /gnyis po'i skyon yod ma yin te/ /snga mas zhen pa med phyir ro/ /rigs pas gnas lugs dpyad pa'i tshe/ /dgag pa gnyis kyi rnal ma ni/ /go ba mgon po klu sgrub kyis/

/yang dag ji bzhin yongs shes pas/ /med dang yod par mi 'dod pa/ /de phyir med pa par 'gyur na/ /ci phyir yod pa par mi 'gyur/ /gal te yod pa sun phyung bas/ /don gyis 'di ni med par bslan/ /de bzhin med pa sun phyung bas/ /yod par ci yi phyir mi bslan/ /zhes gsungs pa dang cis mi 'gal/ /dbu ma'i tha snyad mi rung ste/ /rtag mtha' bkag tshe chad mtha' sogs/ /mtha' gnyis gang rung bkag pa'i tshe/ /cig shos der ni 'gyur phyir ro/ /kha cig tha snyad tshe na yang / /yod min med min la sogs pa/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros bral smra bar byed/ /'di ni mdo las ston pa yis/ /'jig rten nga dang rtsod byed kyi/ /nga ni 'jig rten mi rtsod de/ /'jig rten yod med gang smra ba/ /nga yang smra zhes gsung dang 'gal/ /'di la dgongs nas zla bas kyang / /tha snyad 'jog tshe yod med sogs/ /'gog na 'jig rten gyis gnod pas/ /yod med so sor smros zhes gsungs/ /rigs pas kyang ni gnod pa ste/ /kun rdzob thams cad mtha' bzhi yi/ /spros pa nyid las ma 'das phyir/ /kun rdzob rnam gzhag mi rung 'gyur/ /myong ba dang 'gal bshad par bya/ /zas gos me chu la sogs pa/ /yod med dris tshe dbu ma pas/ /yod min med min smra byed na/ /skabs kyi don yang mi 'grub cing / /gzhan la klan kar 'gyur ba mthong / /kun rdzob la yang skal don dang / /rgyu yi dus na 'bras bu sogs/ /yod min med min dgos pa'ang yod/ /lhag ma snang rung chos rnams la/ /yod med yin min la sogs pa/ /so sor smra ba dbu ma'i lugs/ /la la bdag dang gang zag gnyis/ /rnam grangs yin smra mu stegs gzhung / /yin phyir tha snyad du yang bdag /med phyir gang zag yod par 'dod/ /sgrub byed bdag med rtogs pa'i blos/ /yul gyi gnas tshul rtogs phyir dang / /bgad 'dzin yul gyi gnas tshul la/ /ma zhugs phyir zhes smra ba thos/ /'o na yum gyi mdo rnams dang /

/klu sgrub yab sras gzhung lugs rnams/ /ma stegs gzhung lugs su 'gyur te/ /de dag rnam grangs gsungs phyir ro/ /de yang mdo las bdag dang ni/ /sems can srog dang gang zag dang / /gso ba skyes bu shed bdag dang / /shed skyes byed po tshor po dang / /shes pa po dang mthong po ste/ /byed pa'i skyes bu bcu gnyis gsungs/ /de don 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ /ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa/ /de srid ngar 'dzin yod ces pa'i/ /ngar 'dzin dmigs yul nga tsam la/ /byed pa'i skyes bu bcu gnyis kyi/ /ming gi rnam grangs btags par bzhed/ /de nyid phung po rnams la ni/ /rnam pa lnga 'am rnam bdun gyis/ /btsal ba'i tshe na mi rnyed kyang / /ma dpyad 'jig rten grags pa'i ngor/ /rang gis nye bar blang bya dang / /cha shas dang ni yan lag la/ /brten nas len pa po dang ni/ /cha shas can dang yan lag can/ /'jog pa shing rta'i dpe dang ni/ /sbyar bar dpal ldan zla bas gsungs/ /rtsod tshe 'di la ma bsnyon cig /'chad tshe slob ma ma bslu zhig /sgrub byed kyang ni ltar snang ste/ /skye med mtshan med spros med rnams/ /rtogs pa'i blo la mtshungs pa ste/ /skye sogs tha snyad du yod phyir/ /gzhan la skyon brjod tshe na bdag /don dam med mthong grol 'gyur na/ /mo gsham bu med mthong bas kyang / /grol bar 'gyur zhes sun 'byin smra/ /sun 'byin 'di ni klu sgrub kyis/ /bdag yod bdag gi yod ces pa/ /'di ni dam pa'i don du log /gang phyir yang dag ji lta ba/ /yongs su shes pas gnyis mi 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa la brjod par snang / /rags pa'i rnam gzhag 'di 'dra la'ang / /'khrul na phra mo ji ltar 'gyur/ /rang lugs tha snyad bdag med dang / /phung sogs don dam med pa la'ang / /thal ba de ni mtshungs 'gyur te/ /rigs pa'i rnam gzhag shes na dpyod/ /gzhung lugs rnam gzhag dor nas ni/ /phal pa'i ngag tsam la brten nas/ /grub mtha'i rnam gzhag 'jog byed pa/

/mkhas pas mthong na bzhad gad gnas/ /chos dang gang zag tshig zur la/ /sbyar ba'i bdag dang chos thams cad/ /bdag med ces pa'i bdag gi don/ /sangs rgyas bskyangs dang zla ba yis/ /ngo bos grub pa la bshad nas/ /tha snyad du yang med par bzhed/ /de dang byed pa'i skyes bu la/ /bdag ces brjod par so sor smros/ /la la gang zag bdag 'gog pa'i/ /rigs pa'i gtso bo gang zag nyid/ /phung po lnga la rnam bdun gyis/ /btsal tshe ma rnyed pa yin pas/ /gang zag dang ni gang zag bdag /khyad par med phyir gnyis ka yang / /tha snyad du yod don dam du/ /med pa dbu ma'i lugs zhes smra/ /gnyis po khyad med mu stegs dang / /mang bkur lugs yin gzhan la med/ /gzhan du chos kyang chos bdag tu/ /'gyur te btsal tshul mtshungs phyir ro/ /'dod na 'phags pa'i rjes thob kyis/ /chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i tshe/ /chos tsam med pa rtogs par 'gyur/ /sgrub byed blo gros rtsing ba yi/ /'bras rtags nyid du shes bya ste/ /de don gang zag rnams bdun gyis/ /btsal tshe rnyed na gang zag gi /bdag tu 'gyur ba'i don yin phyir/ /kha cig dbu ma'i lta ba yis/ /gdul bya'i sems rgyud 'khrid pa'i tshe/ /thog mar nga zhes brjod pa yis/ /rjes 'brang rtog pa'i phreng ba nyid/ /goms pas ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi/ /zhen yul nga nyid rnyed pa'i rtags/ /mtshan ma ci rigs 'byung bar 'dod/ /der rjes nga med ces brjod pa'i/ /rjes 'brang rtog pa goms pa las/ /med dgag blo la shar ba nyid/ /gnas lugs mthar thug rtogs pa yi/ /lhag mthong yin zhes sgrog par byed/ /bdag lta'i zhen yul goms pa yi/ /sgom pa mu stegs lugs yin gyi/ /kha che bye brag smra ba nas/ /dbu ma'i bar la lugs 'di med/ /'di nyid mgon po byams pa yis/ /bdag tu lta ba bskyed mi dgos/ /goms pa thog ma med dus can/ /zhes gsungs pa yis 'di bkag zin/ /nga med ces ni brjod pa yi/

/rjes 'brang rtog pa goms tsam gyis/ /dbu ma'i lta ba rtogs na ni/ /dbu ma'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho las/ /gsungs pa'i rigs pa'i rnam gzhag la/ /thos bsam don med nyid 'gyur te/ /sgom pa'i tshul 'di blun po dang / /mkhas pa gnyis la khyad med phyir/ /'di 'dra lhag mthong yin na ni/ /'di dang zhi gnas zung 'brel du/ /sgom pa mi srid nyid 'gyur te/ /brjod pa'i rjes 'brang nyid min phyir/ /kye ma snyigs ma'i dus 'di mtshar/ /'di 'dra blun pos 'dzin srid na'ang / /dbu ma'i gzhung la sbyangs pas kyang / /'di la yid ches ci zhig yin/ /mdor na theg chen lta spyod gnyis/ /ma 'khrul nyams su len 'dod na/ /mtha' bzhis dben pa'i stong pa nyid/ /snying rje'i snying po can yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o// ༈ //rig 'dzin sdom pa dbang bskur las/ /thog mar thob pa smin byed dang / /de nyid bsrung zhing spel ba la/ /grol byed ces ni rgyud las gsungs/ /smin byed rgyud sde bzhi po la/ /dbang gi dngos gzhi'i rim pa bzhi/ /ye shes thig ler gsungs pa'i phyir/ /sdom pa'i thob tshul rnam bzhir nges/ /kha cig rgyud sde mtha' dag la/ /rang bzo'i chog khrigs sbyar nas ni/ /bka' lung yod pa'i sgrub byed du/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i dbang bskur cig /thob pas dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang / /thob par 'gyur te bde mchog las/ /rgyud 'di ru ni dbang bskur gang / /rgyud rnams kun gyi sgrub por 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs rig pa'i dbang lnga yi/ /ngo sprod tshe na bya spyod gnyis/ /'chad dang rnal 'byor rgyud nyan par/ /dbang bar gsungs pa'i phyir zhes zer/ /'di ni phag mo mngon 'byung dang / /mi g.yo bla med rgyud dag las/ /dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs la/ /rgyud 'di bstan par mi bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gzhan du zhugs pa la'ang / /rgyud 'di bstan par mi bya 'o/

/zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ bzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin dor bar bya/ /dbang bskur gcig gis dbang bskur kun/ /thob na ston pa rgyud sde las/ /dbang chog gcig nyid cis ma gsungs/ /dper na 'dul ba'i las chog bzhin/ /rgyud las spro ba bskyed phyir du/ /phan yon gsungs pa'i gnas skabs dang / /'jigs pa bskyed phyir la dor gyis/ /tshig rnams ji bzhin sgra yin na/ /kye rdo rje yi rtsa rgyud las/ /gal te sangs rgyas gsang ba'i skad/ /mi gsungs na yang 'grongs bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'ang ji bzhin sgra ru 'gyur/ /gong ma'i dbang bskur nang du ni/ /'og ma'i dbang dang nus mnyam pa/ /'dus phyir gong ma'i dbang thob na/ /'og ma 'chad dang nyan par gsungs/ /de tsam gyis ni 'og ma'i dbang / /thob par 'gyur na theg chen gyi/ /mthong lam thob tshe nyan thos dang / /rang rgyal mi slob lam thob 'gyur/ /slar yang dam bca' sgrub phyir du/ /kho bos bdag 'jug blangs pa'i tshe/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo rdor sems las/ /thob pas kho bo gcig brgyud yin/ /kho bo las ni blangs pa rnams/ /gnyis brgyud la sogs yin zhes smra/ /'di dang sgrub byed gong ma gnyis/ /gcig gis grub na cig shos ni/ /don med nyid du 'gyur ba ste/ /bdag 'jug blangs pas kun gyi dbang / /ma chad par ni sgrub dgos na/ /gcig gis kun thob don med 'gyur/ /slob ma'i brgyud pa gzhan dag kyang / /gnyis brgyud sogs kyis ci zhig bya/ /rang nyid bdag 'jug blangs nas ni/ /gcig brgyud 'ba' zhig cis mi byed/ /'phags yul grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams/ /sems can yin phyir 'khrul pa srid/ /des na ma 'khrul cho ga ni/ /kho bos rgyud las 'don zhes zer/ /'phags la skur 'debs 'di 'dra'i tshig /thos par gyur na'ang rna ba gdab/ /'o na khyod kyang sems can phyir/ /ci smras tshad mar su yis bzung / /zag med blo mnga'i bstan bcos rnams/ /drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bor ni/

/blang bya yin par byams pas gsungs/ /ku ku ri pa kun snying sogs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ /'khrul pa med par sangs rgyas gsungs/ /de dag 'khrul lo zhes brjod pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la'ang brgal bar snang / /des na bdag nyid legs 'dod rnams/ /rdo rje 'chang nas 'phags yul gyi/ /grub chen rnams las rim brgyud cing / /lo paṇa khyad par can gyis bsgyur/ /de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ /brgyud pa ma nyams dbang bskur zhus/ /dbang dang dam tshig la gnas pa/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa yin/ /deng sang sngags par rlom pa 'ga'/ /dbang gis ma smin skye bo la/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i gsang spyod kun/ /'dzem bag med par gsang sgrog byed/ /'di ni dam pa dang po dang / /rdo rje gur dang dgra nag dang / /rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i gzhung rnams las/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba nyid du gsungs/ /rtsa ltung don yang ma bsrung na/ /nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba dang / /bsrung na dngos grub rtsa bar ni/ /gsungs phyir legs 'dod bag yod mdzod/ /kha cig sngags kyi sdom ldan kun/ /rdo rje spun du byas na ni/ /ha cang rgya ches skyon yod phyir/ /bla ma gcig dang dkyil 'khor ni/ /gcig las dus gcig dbang thob pa/ /rdo rje'i spun yin gzhan du na/ /mngal gyi sgo ni mi gcig phyir/ /spun gyi don mi gnas zhes zer/ /'o na bslab gsum ldan pa kun/ /tshangs pa mtshungs spyod min 'gyur te/ /ha cang rgya ches skyon yod phyir/ /'dod na rnam bshad rigs pa las/ /tshangs pa mya ngan 'das yin te/ /de yi ched du spyod pa ni/ /bslab gsum yin te de ldan kun/ /tshangs pa mtshungs spyod gsung dang 'gal/ /yul chen sum cu rtsa gnyis su/ /spyod pa'i tshe na brda dang ni/ /brda yi lan shes gang zag kun/ /rdo rje spun dang sring mo ni/ /ma yin 'gyur te de dag la/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid ma tshang phyir/ /'dod na bde mchog kye rdor gyi/ /rtsa ba'i rgyu dang kha sbyor las/

/gang gis spun dang sring mor yang / /the tshom med par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi nyams rkyen ma byed cig /mngal sgo gcig dang mi gcig don/ /dris na rang bzo ma yin par/ /lung dang mthun pa khyod la med/ /'jig rten tha snyad dang 'gal te/ /'khor lo sgyur ba gcig nyid kyi/ /btsun mo lnga brgya'i sras rnams kun/ /rigs kyi spun yang ma yin par/ /'gyur te mngal sgo mi gcig phyir/ /kha cig theg pa gsum char gyi/ /tshogs lam chen po yan chad ni/ /sngags lam kho nas thob par 'dod/ /sgrub byed chos rgyun ting 'dzin la/ /brten nas sangs rgyas zhing bgrod tshe/ /lam gyi zab shos gdul byas kyang / /nyan 'dod yod cing sangs rgyas la/ /de ston mkhyen brtse mnga' phyir dang / /kun rigs khyams la bkod pa yi/ /nyan rang rnams kyang sngags lam gyis/ /thob pa'i nyan rang mtshan nyid pa/ yin pa'i phyir zhes smra bar byed/ 'di ni mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang / rigs pa kun dang 'gal ba ste/ mi pham mgon pos theg chen gyi/ /lam du chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin/ /gsungs kyi dman pa'i lam dag la/ /chos rgyun ting 'dzin thob pa ni/ /tshad ldan gzhung las gsungs pa med/ /rigs pas kyang ni gnod pa ste/ /dman pa'i mthong lam snga rol du/ /chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin thob na/ /bsam gtan dngos gzhi thob dgos pas/ /de yis 'phags lam thob pa'i tshe/ /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong mi srid dang / /'bras bu gsum pa la gnas pa'i/ /chags bral sngon song kho nar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang 'dul ba lung dag las/ /nyan thos slob pa lta zhog gi /dgra bcom thob kyang rdzu 'phrul ni/ /ma thob mang du bstan pa dang / /khyod kyi grub mtha' 'di nyid 'gal/ /lam gyi zab shos yin tsam gyis/ /gdul byas nyan 'dod yod par ni/ /ma nges gzhan du theg gsum gyi/ /rim pa bstan pa don med 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dngos kyis gdul bya la/ /sngags lam ston pa ma nges te/

/gdul bya'i blo yi rim pa dang / /'tshams par ston par gsungs phyir ro/ /de yang kye rdor rtsa rgyud las/ /gdul bya bkri ba'i rim pa'i tshul/ /sdom pa rim bzhin blangs nas ni/ /grub mtha' bzhi dang rgyud sde bzhir/ /rim gyis bslab pa'i bkri tshul gsungs/ /lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo las kyang / /ji ltar nad pa nad pa la/ /sman pas sman rnams gtong ba ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la/ /ci tsam bzod pa'i chos ston to/ /zhes gsungs mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ /brda sprod pa dag ji lta bu/ /yi ge'i phyi mo klog 'jug ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas gdul bya la/ /ci tsam bzod pa'i chos ston to/ /zhes gsungs 'phags pa lha yis kyang / /yod dang med dang yod med dang / /gnyis ka min zhes kyang bstan te/ /nad kyi dbang gis thams cad kyang / /sman du 'gyur ba ma yin nam/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa tshad ma yin/ /lam gyi mthar thug sngags lam las/ /'bras bu'i dman shos thob bo zhes/ /smra ba rgyu dang 'bras bu la/ /skur ba 'debs pa'i smra ngan yin/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lha la nyan rang mtshan nyid pa/ /yod na sngags sdom ldan pa yis/ /nyan thos dag tu rlom byed pa'i/ /nang du zhag bdun gnas pa la/ /ltung ba 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/ /kun rig khyams kyi nyan rang rnams/ /theg dman rang rgyud pa yin na/ /rigs lnga'i gdan gyi seng ge sogs/ /dud 'gro rang rgyud par 'gyur zhing / /zla ba nyi ma la sogs kyang / /nam mkha'i nyi zla sogs su 'gyur/ /grub mthar gyi na smra ba po/ /'dis ni dbang bskur dus su yang / /rgyun bshags ma bzung sngon rol du/ /byang chub gsum po gang 'dod la/ /dmigs nas rjes zlos gyis zhes zer/ /sdom pa bsgrag tshe rtse mo las/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spong / /zhes pa bsgrags nas bzung ba'i tshe/

/theg pa dman la 'dod pa sogs/ /'gal zla gsum po bzung ba 'gal/ /kun slong theg dman sems bskyed kyis/ /blangs nas byang chub sems bla med/ /dam pa bdag gis gzung bar bgyi/ /zhes smra 'di ni ci zhig yin/ /nyan thos sa ru sems bskyed na/ /theg chen smon sems spong dgos shing / /smon sems spangs na rtsa ltung du/ /'gyur bar rgyud sde bzhi char mthun/ /gzhan yang rgyud sde phal cher dang / /grub pa'i dbang gzhung bzang rnams/ /'di la gcig tu gnod pa ste/ /gzhung lugs mthong tshe gsal bar 'gyur/ /kha cig bya rgyud skyed chog la/ /bdag bskyed spyod rgyud gzhung 'grel gyi/ /lung gis bsgrub cing rigs pa yang / /bltas pa'i bde ba lam byed dang / /rnam snang mngon byang gzhi gnyis po/ /bdag mdun gnyis la bshad rung na/ /bsam gtan phyi ma'i gzhi gnyis kyang / /bdag mdun gnyis su rung bar mtshungs/ /bdag bskyed med par bshad pa ni/ /bya rgyud phal la dgongs pa 'am/ /srog rtsol la sogs bsam gtan gyi/ /yan lag bsgom par mi nus pa'i/ /gdul bya rnams la dgongs zhes zer/ /spyod rgyud lung gis bya rgyud la/ /bdag bskyed 'grub na bla med kyi/ /lung gis bskyed rdzogs cis mi 'grub/ /bya spyod gnyis kyi skyed chog la/ /bdag bskyed yod par khyad med na/ /nyams len khyad par gang gis 'byed/ /rgyud sde gong ma'i lung dang 'gal/ /bltas pa'i bde ba lam byed kyis/ bdag bskyed yod par mi 'grub ste/ mdun bskyed pho mo bltas pa la/ /dmigs pas lam byed de 'grub phyir/ /rgyud sde gnyis kyi gzhi yi don/ /bdag mdun gnyis su mi mtshungs te/ /rnam snang mngon par byang chub las/ /yi ge dang ni yi ge sbyar/ /de bzhin gzhi las gzhir gyur pa/ /zhes gsungs bsam gtan phyi ma las/ /sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /zhes pa gzhi ni gcig gsungs phyir/ /yi ge gnyis dang sgra sems gnyis/

/sngon 'gro'i don du mtshungs pas na/ /dngos gzhi gzhi gnyis gcig gi ni/ /khyad par yod pas de gnyis kyi/ /bdag bskyed yod med khyad 'grub ste/ /bsam gtan phyi ma'i gzhi yi don/ /mdun bskyed nyid la bshad dgos phyir/ /skyon spong gnyis kyang mi 'thad de/ /bya rgyud phal la bltas pa yi/ /bde ba lam byed med 'gyur ba'am/ /lam dang gdul bya'i gtso bo gnyis/ /go rim log pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /kha cig ngan song sbyong rgyud las/ /gsungs pa'i gtso bo phyag rdor la/ /rgyal chen bzhi sogs kyis bskor ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi 'khor gyi lha/ /'jig rten rang rgyud pa zhes smra/ /sgrub byed dris tshe dam bca' 'god/ /la la bla ma gsungs zhes zer/ /srog snying phul nas dkyil 'khor la/ /bkod pa'i phyir dang 'jig rten pa/ /zhes pa'i ming dang ldan phyir dang / /rgyud gsungs 'khor gyi tshangs pa sogs/ /yin pa'i phyir zhes 'god par byed/ /de bzhin dpal mchog las gsungs pa'i/ /ming po kha skong gi dpe phal cher las 'di bzhin 'byung yang / ming po gsum dang sring mo bzhi dpal mchog na yod cing / ngag dbang chos grags kyi rnam bshad na'ang de bzhin gsungs so/ sring mo bzhi bzhi dang / /sman bla'i khyams la bkod pa yi/ /gnod sbyin tshangs pa la sogs pa/ bcu bdun lha tshogs 'jigs byed kyi/ /'khor gyi gshin rje pho mo dang / /lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug dang / /dpal mgon gdong bzhi gnyen po dang / /pu tra la sogs las mkhan dang / /bya nag khyi nag la sogs pa/ /sprul pa'i pho nya thams cad kyang / /'jig rten rang rgyud pa zhes smra/ /'di dag sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul la/ /skur 'debs yin pas dgag par bya/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /gtso bo nas bzung me ri'i bar/ /gtso bo nyid kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /ma gtogs rgyud ni tha dad dang / /rten dang brten pa rdzas tha dad/ /gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam gzhag ni/

/rgyud dang grub pa'i gzhung bzang dang / /dam pa'i gsung las thos pa med/ /'di ni 'dus pa rnam gnyis sogs/ /rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor sprul bshad kyi/ /skabs dang rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las/ /'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga / /zhes sogs rtogs na 'bad med 'grub/ /khyad par dkyil 'khor drug po yi/ /'khor rnams 'jig rten pa yin na/ /bdag bskyed bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i tshe/ /skyed chog tshul lugs ji ltar bya/ /phyag rdor thugs khar bskyed pa yi/ /'jig rten pa de ngo mtshar che/ /dkyil 'khor drug po 'di dag la/ /bsnyen pa rgyas pa mi 'jug na/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan gsung rab las/ /sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis la/ /dkyil 'khor sum cu so drug tu/ /phye ba'i mtshan gzhi gang yin smros/ /bdag bskyed tshe na gtso bos sprul/ /sgrub tshe ye shes dgug gzhug dang / /mchod tshe sgeg sogs kyis mchod dang / /bstod tshe phyag 'tshal tshig brjod dang / /rgyun bshags skyabs 'gro'i yul byas dang / /'jug tshe me tog 'dor ba dang / /sngags bzlas bum chus dbang bskur ba/ /rgyud dang gong ma'i gsung rab las/ /'byung phyir 'jig rten pa yin zhes/ /sems ldan su zhig smra bar nus/ /de dag gtso 'khor khyad par la/ /yod med smra na rgyud dang 'gal/ /sprul pa mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang thob tsam gyis grub pa'i sa/ /thob dang dkyil 'khor de yi lha/ /'jig rten rang rgyud pa yod 'gal/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs kyis/ /sgo srung byas pa'i dkyil 'khor nang / /sdod par nus pa'i 'jig rten pa/ /rang rgyud pa de ci 'dra zhig /sgrub byed la yang dpyad par bya/ /dam bcas dam bca' sgrub na ni/ /pha rol dam bca' bzlog pa yis/ /dam bca' de nyid 'gog par 'gyur/ /rje btsun mkhyen pa'i dbang po des/ /bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i chos gar ni/ /rigs bzhi nas ni 'khor yug bar/

/kun rig thugs kar bskyed nas ni/ /so sor bkod pa sprul pa'i sku/ /nyams len yin gsungs khyad par du/ /sangs rgyas gang la gang 'dul ba/ /de dang de yi skur ston ces/ /'khor yug bar du sbyar te gsungs/ /'di dang khyed kyi gsung sgros 'gal/ /de la skyon spong 'di skad du/ /kun rig 'khor yug lha rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas yin zhing cig shos ni/ /'jig rten rang rgyud pa zhes smra/ /kye ma 'di 'dra'i tshig gis kyang / /shes ldan nges pa skye ba re/ /kun rig dkyil 'khor phyi rol du/ /'khor yug la bkod lha klu sogs/ /sangs rgyas yin zhing phyag rdor gyi/ /dkyil 'khor nang bkod ye shes pas/ /sgo srung byas pa'i lha rnams kyang / /'byung po yin na 'di tsam gyi/ /khyad par kun rig phyag rdor gnyis/ /bzang ngan dbang cha che chung gang / /bla mas 'chad tshe zor yang phyir/ /'jig rten pa zhes gsungs tsam la/ /bla ma'i gsung sgros yin no zhes/ /bla ma mchog la skur mi bya/ /srog snying phul ba'i tshul ston pa/ /tsam gyis 'jig rten par 'gyur na/ /gdul bya drag po dbang phyug che/ /'dul byed he ru kas 'dul ba'i/ /rnam 'phrul cha shas tsam gyis kyang / /de gnyis rgyud gcig ji ltar 'gyur/ /de sogs sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul la/ /rang gi blo tshod sbyar mi rung / /'jig rten pa zhes bya ba yi/ /ming gis 'jig rten par 'gyur na/ /mi la seng ge'i ming btags tshe/ /sna nyag ral pa sprug par 'gyur/ /ming don ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /'brel bar 'dod pa rig byed gzhung / /yin phyir rigs pa'i rgyal pos bkag /ming la dngos ming btag ming gnyis/ /gsung rab 'chad pa kun la grags/ /'jig rten tha snyad la yang yod/ /'on kyang sgrub byed gtso bo ni/ /'di nyid la ni re bar snang / /ston pas rgyud sde gsungs pa'i tshe/ /'khor la rang rgyud pas khyab na/ /sprul pa dang ni rang rgyud pa'i/ /'khor gnyis rgyud las gsung dang 'gal/

/ston pas rgyud sde 'di gsungs tshe/ /'khor gyi tshangs sogs sprul pa nyid/ /yin phyir kun rig 'khor yug tu/ /tshang bar bkod cing phyag rdor gyis/ /brtag pa phyi ma gsungs pa'i tshe/ /srog snying phul nas rang nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor la ni so sor bkod/ /de tshe dkyil 'khor rnam drug 'byung / /dpal mchog las gsungs lha rnams kyang / /'jig rten rang rgyud pa yin pa'i/ /sgrub byed snga ma las gzhan med/ /kun dga' snying pos sprul par bshad/ /sman bla'i gnod sbyin la sogs pa/ /'jig rten rang rgyud pa yin na/ /sman bla'i cho ga byas pa kun/ /skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa 'chor 'gyur te/ /'jig rten pa yi lha rnams la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs 'gro byas pa'i phyir/ /zhi 'tshos mdo las gsungs pa yi/ /bde gshegs brgyad po sangs rgyas su/ /byas nas skabs der dam chos bsnan/ /lhag ma skyabs grol la sogs pa/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /skur ston dge 'dun du byas nas/ /skyabs gnas gsum la phyag mchod sogs/ /yan lag drug po dngos su sbyar/ /bdun pa mdo yi smon lam nyid/ /sbyar ba sman bla'i cho ga yin/ /don yod rdo rjes 'jigs byed kyi/ /gsung las rdor sems yab yum gyi/ /mngal nas gshin rje pho brgyad phyung / /srung 'khor rtsibs brgyad la bkod nas/ /rdor sems zhu ba'i gzhal yas dbus/ /'jigs byed gshin rje mo brgyad dang / /bcas pa bskyed par gsungs pa'i phyir/ /de dag 'byung por sus smra nus/ /'dod khams dbang phyug 'jig rten pa/ /yin na bram ze mchog sred kyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa dang / /rigs lnga'i yum du bshad dang 'gal/ /gdong bzhi gnyen po 'jig rten pa/ /yin na rdo rje 'chang dbang gi /thugs kyi phrin las las sprul dang / /ston pa'i nying sprul du bshad 'gal/ /las mgon lnga po 'jig rten pa/ /yin na mgon po lcam dral gyi/ /thugs ka'i sa bon las brgyud de/

/rim pa bzhin du bskyed pa 'gal/ /sprul pa'i bya nag khyi nag sogs/ /'jig rten rang rgyud pa yin na/ /sprul pa'i pho nya zhes brjod pa'i/ /tshig dang 'gal bar mi 'gyur ram/ /des na brtse chen sa paṇa gyis/ /kye ma bsod nams dman pa'i mi/ /lha skal chad pa 'byung po bsgrub/ /ces gsungs yid la bzhag nas ni/ /yi dam chos skyong phal che ba/ /'byung po yin zhes ma smra zhig /skyabs gnas mchog la the tshom gyi/ /rgyu yin phyir na nyes dmigs che/ /des na phan pa'i gdams ngag ni/ /nyan thos rang rgyal skur ston la/ /sangs rgyas byang sems sprul pa dang / /rang rgyud pa dang rnam gsum yod/ /tshangs dang brgya byin la sogs pa/ /'jig rten che dgu mtha' dag dang / /dur khrod bdag po sha za'i tshogs/ /'jig rten cha lugs ldan rnams dang / /ri bong stag dang seng ge sogs/ /rigs drug 'gro ba'i gzugs ston kun/ /snga ma bzhin du rnam gsum yod/ /de 'dra'i rnam dbye mdo rgyud kyi/ /dgongs pa yin phyir sangs rgyas kyi/ /rnam 'phrul mtha' yas shes par bya/ /la la rgyud sde 'og ma la/ /dbang bzhi med pas de la ni/ /ltos pa'i rim pa gnyis med kyang / /rim gnyis nges par 'dod dgos te/ /rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung yin phyir/ /de yang sangs rgyas phrin yig las/ /bcom ldan khyod kyis gsang sngags lam/ /rim pa gnyis su bsdus te bstan/ /zhes gsungs sdom gsum rab dbye las/ /dbang dang rim gnyis mi ldan pas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa min/ /zhes gsungs pa yi phyir zhes zer/ /'o na rgyud sde 'og ma la'ang / /dbang bzhi yod pa nyid 'gyur te/ /rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung yin phyir/ /de yang bstan bcos 'di nyid las/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /smin grol gnyis la 'bad dgos pa'i/ /smin byed dbang bzhi nyid la ni/ /gsungs shing gzhan yang de nyid las/ /gal te gsang sngags bsgom 'dod na/

/nor ba med pa'i dbang bzhi longs/ /zhes sogs mtshungs par gsungs phyir ro/ /dbang bskur bzhi la ma ltos pa'i/ /rim gnyis sngon med gtam yin te/ /sa bon 'debs la ma ltos pa'i/ /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /blo yis rim gyis lha bskyed tsam/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i don min te/ /bskyed rim sbyang gzhi sbyong byed gnyis/ /sbyar ba nyid la gsungs phyir ro/ /mtshan med rnal 'byor bsgom pa tsam/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i don min te/ /rdzogs rim lus ngag yid gsum ni/ /rdzogs pa nyid la gsungs phyir ro/ /kha cig bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis la/ /snang ba lha ru 'char ba'i don/ /yid ngor rten dang brten pa yi/ /lha dang ye shes bsgom pa'i tshe/ /rtog gnyis cig car mi 'jug pas/ /yid ngo'i snang ba der 'char ba'i/ /don yin phyi rol snang ba kun/ /lha ru 'char ba ma yin te/ /log shes nyid du thal phyir dang / /phyi rol snang ba lhar bsgom pas/ /lha ru 'gyur ba ma yin te/ /rang bzhin rnam dag lha min phyir/ /sol ba brdar bas dung bzhin no/ /zhes pas srub mtha' 'dzug pa mthong / /'di ni rnal 'byor bla med kyi/ /gnad bcos pa yi bdud kyi tshig /yin phyir lung dang rigs pa dang / /khas blangs 'gal bas dgag par bya/ /de yang gsang ba 'dus pa las/ /mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu bsgrags/ /rdo rje'i skye mched nyid dag kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /sa ni spyan zhes bya bar bshad/ /chu yi khams ni mā ma kī/ /gos dkar mo dang sgrol ma ni/ /me dang rlung du rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs de don spyod bsdus las/ /tha mal dngos po rigs rnams brgyar/ /phye nas de dag 'dus pa yi/ /dam pa rigs brgyar bsgom tshul gsungs/ /'di dang khyod kyi grub mtha' 'gal/ /de bzhin kye rdor rtsa rgyud las/ /phung po lnga dang nyon mongs lnga/ /khams lnga bzhi dang skye mched drug

/bdag med lha mo bco lnga yi/ /lha ru bsgom par gsungs pa 'di/ /khyod kyi grub mtha'i gnyen po yin/ /de bzhin bde mchog bshad rgyud las/ /phung po skye mched khams bcu bdun/ /rnam snang la sogs sangs rgyas su/ /bsgom par gsungs shing so sen sogs/ /lus kyi khams ni nyi shu bzhi/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhir ni/ /bsgom par gsungs dang de bzhin du/ /'phags yul grub thob gsungs rnams dang / /bod yul sngon gyi sngags 'chang gi /man ngag thams cad khyod kyi ni/ /grub mtha' 'di yi gnyen po yin/ /des na spang bya de dor bya/ /snang ba lha yi ngo bor ni/ /rang bzhin gyis ni rnam dag ni/ /de bsgom lha ru mi 'gyur dang / /de 'char log shes yin pa 'gal/ /lha yi ngo bo rang bzhin gyis/ /rnam dag ma yin brtag gnyis las/ /nges par dngos po thams cad kyi/ /dag pa de bzhin nyid du brjod/ /phyi nas re re'i dbye ba yis/ /lha rnams kyis ni brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs de yi sgrub byed du/ /phung po lnga dang dbang po drug /skye mched drug dang 'byung chen lnga/ /rang bzhin gyis ni rnam par dag /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib sbyang bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur/ /de nyid dag pa dang po yi/ /sgrub byed yin gyi lha yi ni/ /dag pa'i sgrub byed min snyam na/ /lha yi rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bzhin lag kha dog gnas pa ni/ /skyes pa tsam gyis rnam par gnas/ /'on kyang bag chags phal pas so/ /zhes gsungs dang cis mi 'gal/ /gzhan yang lugs 'di smra ba pos/ /sbyang gzhi ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi/ /skye 'chi bar do kho na dang / /sbyong byed gnas skabs de nyid kyi/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa kho na dang / /sbyong tshul chos gsum dod du ni/ /sku gsum 'byung bar sgro btags pa/ /gzhan du bkag zin lta bar bya/ /kha cig snang ba'i dngos kun la/ /mtshan nyid gsum du phye ba yi/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang kun rdzob nyid/

/yin phyir lha ru bsgom bya min/ /yongs grub don dam lha yin phyir/ /bsgoms pas lha ru 'gyur ba ste/ /glo bur dri ma bral ba'i tshe/ /don dam lha nyid mngon 'gyur phyir/ /rgyud las phung khams skye mched sogs/ /dngos kun lha ru gsungs pa yang / /'di la dgongs te de dag gi /yongs grub lha nyid yin phyir ro/ /ye shes tshogs bsag dus su yang / /spros bral nyid la a haṃ zhes/ /nga rgyal 'jog pa'ang 'di nyid de/ /'og tu lha ni bsgom phyir lo/ /'di la lung rigs khas blangs dang / /'gal ba gsum las lung 'gal ni/ /kye rdor rtsa ba'i rgyud nyid las/ /nges par dngos po thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs de bzhin nyid kyi ni/ /phyi nas kun rdzob spros pa kun/ /lha ru bsgom par gsungs pa dang / /khyod kyi grub mtha' 'di nyid 'gal/ /bsgom gzhi chos dbyings nyid yin na/ /re re zhes pa dang 'gal te/ /re re zhes pa so so'i tshig /chos dbyings so sor med phyir ro/ /de bzhin brtag pa phyi mar yang / /kun rdzob gzugs su gnas nas ni/ /de rnams bde gshegs rigs su 'gyur/ /bud med rnams kyi mtshan nyid 'di/ /ji ltar skyes pa de bzhin no/ /kun rdzob tha snyad tshul las ni/ /de yi rigs su'ang de 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs bshad rgyud gur las kyang / /don la 'gal ba yod min yang / /rgyal ba'i dngos pos sbyangs pa yod/ /kun rdzob gzugs su gnas nas ni/ /'khor lo'i gzugs kyi chos tsam brtag /ces gsungs de bzhin gsang 'dus la/ /sogs pa'i rgyud sde thams cad las/ /kun rdzob spros pa'i dbye ba kun/ /lha ru bsgom par gsung dang 'gal/ /rigs pas kyang ni gnod pa ste/ /gzhan dbang gis bsdus chos can la/ /tha mal rnam rtog yod pa'i phyir/ /de dag lha ru bsgom dgos te/ /gzhan du srid pa'i 'ching ba las/ /grol ba'i thabs ni med par gsungs/ /de yang ye shes zhabs nyid kyis/ /tha mal rnam rtog rgyun de las/

/gzhan du srid pa'i 'ching ba med/ /de dang rnam pa 'gal ba'i sems/ /gang yin kun rtog snang mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yis legs par grub/ /chos dbyings spros bral rang ngos nas/ /lha ru bsgom na spros med la/ /spros par byas phyir spros pa gzhan/ /'gog pa thabs ni med par 'gyur/ /de skad du yang brtag gnyis las/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa bsgom/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /sgom pa po med bsgom pa'ang med/ /lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin/ /zhes pa spros pa spros med du/ /byed pa'i lung yin bzlog pa min/ /sgra dang rtog pa'i yul gyur pa'i/ /chos dbyings kun rdzob yin pa'i phyir/ /tha mal rnam rtog bzlog ched du/ /rdo rje sems dpa'am chos dbyings mar/ /bsgom par rgyud gzhung rnams las gsungs/ /'di yang kun rdzob lhar bsgom zhing / /don dam spros bral rang ngos nas/ /lhar mi bsgom pa'i rigs pa yin/ /gang la smad na rtsa ba yi/ /ltung ba brgyad pa 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /chos nyid yin na rigs pas gnod/ /chos can yin na khas blangs 'gal/ /khas blangs 'gal ba bstan bya ste/ /bskyed pa'i rim pas thun mong nyid/ /'grub kyi mchog mi 'grub pa dang / /bskyed pa'i rim pas gang bsgom pa/ /don dam chos sku yin pa 'gal/ /bskyed rim bsgom pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /gzugs sku yin na chos nyid ni/ /gzugs skur 'gyur ba bzlog tu med/ /de yang 'dod na gzugs kyi sku/ /kun rdzob yin zhing chos kyi sku/ /don dam yin par khas blangs pa'i/ /rang gi grub mtha' nyid dang 'gal/ /bskyed rim gzugs sku'i rgyu min na/ /rdzogs rim chos sku'i rgyu nyid du/ /'grub par mi 'gyur bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ /sku gnyis rgyur ni rgyud las gsungs/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed 'chol ba yi/ /rnam gzhag ngan pa 'di dor la/ /don dam spros bral ma rtogs pas/

/kun rdzob 'khor ba'i phung sogs kyi/ /snang ba sna tshogs 'byung ba kun/ /'ching grol kun gyi gzhi yin pas/ /lha yi ngo bor rang bzhin gyi/ /rnam par dag phyir lha bsgoms pas/ /lha ru 'gyur bar gsungs pa 'di/ /rgyud dang grub pa'i gzhung bzang gi /dgongs pa yin phyir gser rgyan ltar/ /blo gros lus la 'dogs par gyis/ /da ni lam gyi yan lag dang / /'phral gyi lag len 'ga' zhig kyang / /'khrul na bstan la gnod mthong nas/ /che long tsam zhig brjod par bya/ /lha rnams tshim par bya ba dang / /sngags kyi 'bras bu 'byin pa'i phyir/ /rdzas sngags grangs mnyam bgrangs pa yi/ /sbyin sreg bya bar rgyud las gsungs/ /deng sang sbyin sreg byed pa 'ga'/ /rdzas sngags bcu tsam yun tshod la/ /gcig bcu nyi shu sum cu sogs/ /brjod nas brgya tham thal lo zhes/ /skad po che yis logs nas bgrangs/ /de yang sbyin sreg grangs su byed/ /'chi bslu'i tshe na 'chi bdag la/ /bre srang zho chas rdzas gzhal tshe/ /'di 'dra'i mgo skor byed pa bshad/ /so so skye bos sangs rgyas la/ /mgo skor byed pa e ma mtshar/ /'di yis 'bras bu ci zhig 'grub/ /des na rdzas sngags re re bzhin/ /bgrangs pa'i grangs kyis las bzhi la/ /so so'i rdzas sngags gtsor byas pa'i/ /bsnyen pa'i bcu cha bsgrub par bya/ /kha cig gtor mgron la sogs pa'i/ /mdun bskyed gshegs tshe dam tshig pa/ /gshegs nas ye shes pa rang la/ /bsdu ste de yi rgyu mtshan yang / /de gnyis bzang ngan tha dad phyir/ /ngan pa gshegs nas bzang po ni/ /rang la bsdu ba yin zhes zer/ /'di 'dra blun po'i rigs pa ste/ /'o na mgron bzang bos pa'i tshe/ /bsnyen bkur byas rjes mgron bzang nyid/ /'khor du bsdus nas de'i tshab tu/ /g.yog ngan gzhan zhig gtong dgos 'gyur/ /yo gar bdag nyid dam tshig par/ /bskyed nas ye shes pa bcug ste/ cho ga tshar nas gshegs pa'i tshe/ /tshul 'di ci yi phyir mi mtshungs/

/lung rigs man ngag med pa yi/ /grub mtha' blun po'i khyad nor yin/ /de gnyis bzang ngan tha dad du/ /'dzin pa yod pa de nyid kyis/ /spyan drangs pa nyid gshegs dgos te/ /tshogs bsag zhing tsam yin pa'i phyir/ /bzang ngan tha dad 'dzin med na/ /de 'dra'i blang dor bya ci dgos/ /mi 'khrugs mgon po'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ /tshul bzhin bris nas gnam rgyan la/ /btags pas de 'og 'gro rnams kyi/ /bsod nams spel phyir mkhas rnams mdzad/ /'di la kha cig 'khor gyi dbu/ /phyir bstan bris na blos slong tshe/ /dbu rnams thur bstan 'byung bas na/ /lha mgo nang du bstan zhes zer/ /'o na gzhal yas khang la yang / /mda' yab pu shu la sogs pa/ /nang nas rim bzhin bris nas ni/ /rtsig pa phyi ru 'dri dgos 'gyur/ /de ltar byas kyang gzhas yas kyi/ /steng du 'og gzhi 'byung ba'i phyir/ /lha sogs mtshan ma gtan med par/ /'og gzhi kho na 'dri dgos 'gyur/ /gtso zhal shar bstan 'dri na ni/ /blos slong tshe na nub bstan 'gyur/ /nub bstan 'dri na de 'dra ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor rgya bod su yis byas/ /'og gzhir spyi gtsug bstad nas ni/ /phyi nas slong na mgo mjug bsgyur/ /nang nas slong na gtso bo la/ /rgyab bstan gsum las ma 'das pas/ /'di 'dra'i dkyil 'khor yul phyogs de'i/ /gtso 'khor kun gyi rten 'brel la/ /gnod phyir rgyal po'i khrims yod na/ /rnam pa kun tu dgag par rigs/ /logs la dkyil 'khor 'dri ba la/ /blos slong tshe na ji ltar 'gyur/ /de bcos pa yi thabs su ni/ /'dri lugs ci yin smra dgos so/ /des na sa la bkram pa 'am/ /logs la 'grems sam gnam rgyan la/ /'dogs pa gang zhig yin yang rung / /'dri lugs khyad med shes dgos so/ /sman bla'i pho brang zhes bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams tsa ka lir/ /bris pa kha phyir bstan nas ni/ /mchod rten bang rim lta bur byed/ /mig lam mdzes pa ltar snang bas/

/nyang shab gtsang gi phyogs 'dir dar/ /'di yang nyang ston sgom chen gyi/ /nyams snang las byung yin par grags/ /nyams snang bdud kyi min na rung / /mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnam dag las/ /'di 'dra'i dkyil 'khor gsungs pa med/ /des na cir 'gyur brtag dgos so/ /rten gyi gzhal yas khang med par/ /lha yi bkod pa tsam yin na/ /rung mod 'di la gtso bo med/ /khong stong bzhag pas mi shis so/ /gal te steng du po ti nyid/ /bzhag pa gtso bo yin snyam na/ /de lta yin na gtso bo la/ /'khor gyi lha rnams rgyab bstan pas/ /phyi nang rten 'brel kun la gnod/ /bod kyi 'bangs rnams rgyal po la/ /ngo log byed pa la sogs kyang / /de nas dar bas spang bar bya/ /mchod rten logs la lha bri ba/ /bshad pa med mod byed na yang / /dkyil 'khor rnam gzhag ma yin pas/ /bsod nams bsag phyir 'gal ba med/ /'di yi tshul lugs zhi ba 'tshos/ /bya rgyud spyi yi dkyil 'khor dang / /mthun pa'i rnam gzhag gsungs pa nyid/ /nyams su blangs na dge legs 'byung / /kha cig ngan song sbyong rgyud nas/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga mi byed par/ /gshin po'i ming byang bsregs pa yis/ /dad rdzas mang du len pa mthong / /dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo sde las/ /dad rdzas za ba'i nyes mthong nas/ /dge slong lnga brgyas bslab pa phul/ /de la ston pas legs zhes gsungs/ /gzhan yang 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs las/ /mi slob pa ni bdag por spyod/ /slob pa byin par spyod pa ste/ /bsam gtan klog dang ldan pa ni/ /rjes gnang spyod pas nyes pa med/ /lhag ma le los bcom pa yi/ /bdag nyid rnams ni bu lon spyod/ /ces gsungs sngon gyi skyes chen 'gas/ /stong nyid 'ju rtsi ma rtogs pa/ /dad rdzas 'ju ba ngas ma mthong / /zhes gsungs yid la bzhag nas ni/ /dad rdzas 'ju bar 'dod gyur na/ /tshul khrims rnam dag dang ldan pas/ /bsam gtan klog la brtson par bya/ /khyad par gshin po rjes 'dzin na/

/ngan song sbyong rgyud la sogs las/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga tshul bzhin du/ /bya bar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsungs/ /de phyir 'di la gzab par bya/ /dkyil 'khor lha bkod tshangs dbang dang / /gnod sbyin bcu gnyis rgyal chen rnams/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten skur ston pa/ /yin phyir phyag mchod skyabs 'gro dang / /'khor gyi bdun 'bum dang bcas la/ /phyag mchod skyabs 'gro mi byed kyang / /phrin las 'chol ba zhi 'tshos gsungs/ /deng sang rnam dbye mi shes par/ /kha cig dkyil 'khor nang bkod kyang / /'jig rten par 'dod sngar bkag zin/ /la la 'khor g.yog bdun 'bum la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs su 'gro ba mthong / /'di ni skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya la/ /gnod pas zhi 'tshos mi bzhed de/ /'khor g.yog bdun 'bum phal che ba/ /'jig rten rang rgyud pa yin phyir/ /de dag 'dul ba'i ched du ni/ /de dang mthun pa'i skur ston pa/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten skur ston pa'i/ dgos pa yin phyir gzhan la'ang sbyar/ rten gyi nang rdzong gzungs dril tshe/ /phal cher mtha' nas sgril ba mthong / /de tshe oṃ sogs sngags kyi mgo /phyi ru 'byung zhing sngags mjug rnams/ /dbus su 'byung phyir 'di yang ni/ /phyi nang rten 'brel kun la gnod/ /mgo nas sgril na sngags kyi mgo /dbus su 'byung phyir blang bar bya/ /'di ni rdo rje kha skong gi dpe phal cher du 'di bzhin snang yang tshig 'di sgra ji bzhin da lta'i rtse mo na med/ 'gyur gzhan yod na ma nges so/ rtse mo las/ /yi ge oṃ ni ci yin brjod/ /dpal dang grags dang g.yang dang ni/ /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan pa/ /dam bca' ba dang bkra shis don/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun pa ste/ /dam pa gong ma'i phyag len yin/ /gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo gnyis/ /kha sbyar rten gyi zhabs sdom du/ /byas na dpal 'byor 'bras 'byung bar/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las gsungs/

/'di la kha cig sngags kyi mgo /nang bstan byed pa sngar bkag zin/ /la la pho 'khor 'og tu 'dod/ /pho 'khor gtso bo yin na ni/ /tshul 'di shin tu 'thad gyur te/ /gshed dmar lha lnga'i bris sku bzhin/ /rgyud las mo 'khor gtso bor gsungs/ /de tshe mo 'khor 'og nyid du/ /'byung ste sgrol ma bla med bzhin/ /des na gtso mo nor rgyun ma'i/ /mdun dang rten gyi mdun gnyis po/ /phyogs gcig 'byung na 'khrul pa med/ /de sogs gsung rab nas bshad pa'i/ /'phral gyi lag len thams cad kyang / /mkhas la dris nas dag par bya/ /de las dpal 'byor phun tshogs 'byung / /rim mam ci car blangs kyang rung / /sdom gsum cho gar ldan byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len du/ /gsum char bsrung ba sngags sdom yin/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa'i skabs te bzhi pa'o// ༈ //de ltar sdom gsum ldan pa yis/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i lam bsgoms na/ /tshe 'di'am bar do la sogs su/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'grub/ /'di la so so skye bo yis/ /dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i/ /ye shes phyag rgya che bsgoms pas/ /mtshon bya don gyi ye shes 'thob/ /'phags pa'i sa la kye rdo rjer/ /gnas sogs bcu gnyis gsungs pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sar gsungs phyir/ /slob pa'i lam gyi dbye ba yin/ /de tshe phyi nang yul chen ni/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis 'dus pa las/ /gnas nas nye ba'i 'thung gcod bar/ /bcu gnyis sa rnams 'grub par gsungs/ /bde mchog nyung ngu kha sbyor las/ /pha rol phyin dang sgo bstun nas/ /gnas nas nye ba'i dur khrod bar/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi sa bcur bsdus/ /'di la'ang dpe med ye shes ldan/ /bsnan par a bhi dha nar gsungs/ /de phyir slob lam sa bcu gnyis/ /rgyud rgyal gnyis ka dgongs pa mthun/ /nang du sbas pa'i rtsa lnga dang / /phyi ru yul chen lhag ma lnga/ /'dus pas bcu gsum sa bskyed par/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las gsungs/

/'di la kha cig pha rol tu/ /phyin pa'i sa bcu las gzhan pa'i/ /slob lam med pas lhag ma gnyis/ /bcu pa'i nang du 'dus zhes smra/ /phyi rol yul chen sum cu bdun/ /dbang du 'dus pas lus kyi ni/ /rtsa khams sum cu so bdun gyi/ /rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa las/ /sa rnams 'grub pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde las/ /gsungs pas khas len de yi tshe/ /lhag gnyis bcu par ji ltar 'dus/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i sa lam gyi/ /rnam gzhag mi byed de yi tshe/ /bcu gsum sa yi tha snyad med/ /de tshe dbye bsdu don med de/ /gzhan yang dpe med ye shes ldan/ /chos kyi sprin du mi 'dus na/ /gnyis po bcu par ji ltar 'dus/ /'dus na 'thung gcod sogs gnyis las/ /phye ba'i phyi nang yul chen brgyad/ /nye ba'i dur khrod du 'dus 'gyur/ /dgu pa bcu pa gnyis kyang ni/ /brgyad par 'dus zhes mgo bsgre na/ /chos mthun lan nyid ji ltar 'debs/ /pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs kyis/ /rdo rje theg la gnod mi nus/ /nus na pha rol phyin pa la'ang / /grub mtha' 'og ma 'og ma yis/ /gong ma gong mar gnod par 'gyur/ /bskyed rim lha yi rnam gzhag dang / /'gal ba'i tshul yang brjod par bya/ /bdag med lha mo bco lnga yi/ /steng 'og dbus kyi lha mo gsum/ /ghasma rī ru mi 'du na/ /sa gnyis bcu par ji ltar 'dus/ /'dus na lha mo'i grangs nges nyams/ /sa lam de ltar mi sbyor na/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las rtsa so gnyis/ /gsungs pa brtag pa phyi mar ni/ /rtsa ni gnyis gnyis rnal 'byor ma/ /re re'i rnam pa rnams su brjod/ /rkyang ma ro ma kun 'dar ma/ /bdag med mar gsungs 'di dang 'gal/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bde chen dam tshig 'khor lo yi/ /lha rnams gzhan du 'dus mi 'dus/ /dpyad pa'i rigs pa sngar bzhin mtshungs/ /mdor na pha rol phyin pa yi/ /sa lam rnam gzhag phyed pa'i tshe/

/bcu gsum sa yi tha snyad med/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde las/ /gsungs pa'i sa lam rnam gzhag la/ /bcu gsum sa ru 'byed pa'i tshe/ /pha rol phyin la mngon zhen nas/ /de yi lugs dang bstun mi bya/ /gsang ba chen po'i rgyud sde las/ /pha rol phyin dang sgo bstun pa'i/ /rnam gzhag gsungs pa'ang de nyid las/ /mngon zhen che rnams drangs phyir gsungs/ /dpal ldan zla ba grags pa yis/ /mdo sogs la ni rab zhugs pa'i/ /'gyod pa zlog par byed pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa yang 'di la dgongs/ /kha cig pha rol phyin pa nas/ /bshad pa'i sku gsum ye shes bzhi/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bcu gcig sa/ /yin phyir de yi gong du yang / /bcu gnyis bcu gsum bgrod ces zer/ /'di yang pha rol phyin pa las/ /bcu gcig par bshad la 'khrul nas/ /grangs dang mtshan gzhi nor bar zad/ /bye brag smra ba'i gzhung lugs nas/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde'i bar/ /'bras bu'i rnam gzhag gang bshad rnams/ /rang rang gdul bya'i blo nyid la/ /'tshams pa'i yon tan ldog pa nyid/ /smos pa'i khyad par ma gtogs pa/ /mthar thug 'bras bur khyad par med/ /dper na shāka thub yon tan bzhin/ gzhung der 'bras bur bshad pa rnams/ /de yi lam gyis thob dgos na/ /dngos smra'i gzhung las bshad pa yi/ /'bras bu sa mtshams gang du 'jog /'bras bu sku yi rnam gzhag la/ /bye smras rnam grol chos sku dang / /gzugs sku gnyis 'dod longs sprul gyi/ /don dang tha snyad gnyis ka med/ /mdo sde pa sogs gong ma gsum/ /sku gsum ye shes bzhi ru 'dod/ /rgyu sde 'og ma gsum por yang / /sku gsum 'di la cha 'dra la/ /rnam pa'i 'dod tshul so sor yod/ /gzugs sku rigs lngar 'dod pa'i tshe/ /'byung ba lnga dang ye shes lnga/ /dag bya dag byed sbyar nas gsungs/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde las/ /rgyu yi skabs su dbang bzhi dang / /bskyed rim la sogs lam bzhi po/

/bsgoms par sku bzhi 'byung bar bzhed/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug man ngag las/ /drug tshan bzhi ru sbyar ba dang / /sku lnga'i rnam gzhag gsungs pa yod/ /gsang chen yin phyir 'dir ma bshad/ /'jam dpal rang gi lta ba yi/ /'dod pa mdor bstan mdo las kyang / /sku gcig nas ni lnga yi bar/ /rnam gzhag rnam pa lnga ru gsungs/ /sku gcig ye shes sku yin te/ /ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /sku gnyis rang don don dam dang / /gzhan don kun rdzob sku nyid yin/ /sku gsum chos dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /sprul pa'i sku nyid yin par gsungs/ /sku bzhi nyid kyang bshad bya ste/ /ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /de bzhin gzhan pa sprul ba dang / /chos sku mdzad par bcas pa ste/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /ces pa mdo de'i lung tshig yin/ /byams pas ni zhes tshig sbyor tshe/ /sku gsum chos sku'i dbye bar bzhed/ /'dir ni dang zhes 'byed pa'i tshe/ /chos sku dbye ba'i grangs su bzhed/ /sku lnga nyid kyang lung der ni/ /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /sangs rgyas lnga bdag cod pan can/ /spyan lnga chags pa med pa 'chang / /zhes pa'i tshig gis gsungs pa yin/ /de 'dra'i rnam dbye mi shes par/ /kha cig pha rol phyin pa la'ang / /sku bzhi byams pa'i lung nyid kyis/ /'grub par smra ba lung tshig la/ /dpyad pa'i nus pa med par zad/ /des na legs par spyod pa smros/ /mdor na nyan thos theg pa nas/ /gsang chen bla na med pa'i bar/ /'bras bu don gcig bshad pa'i tshul/ /tha dad spro ba bskyed phyir yin/ /'bras bu'i skabs te lnga'o// //de ltar tshul bzhin bshad pa 'di/ /bdag nyid grags pa bsgrags pa 'am/ /zhan la gnod pa'i phyir min te/ /gcig tu bstan la phan phyir yin/ /rgyal bas lung bstan klu sgrub sogs/ /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan rnams kyis/ /'phags pa'i yul du phyi nang gi

/log smra'i mun pa bsal bar mdzad/ /ljongs 'dir rin chen bzang po dang / /bla chen 'brog dang 'gos sogs kyis/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa mchog /bshad sgrub chu bo'i rgyun bzhin mdzad/ /de rjes chos log 'phel ba rnams/ /sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs grags thob des/ /lung rigs 'od kyis rab bsal nas/ /lam bzang snang ba gsal bar mdzad/ /mgon po de nyid slob tshogs dang / /bcas pa zhing gzhan gshegs gyur nas/ /ring zhig lon nas bod yul 'dir/ /lung rigs man ngag dang bral ba'i/ /rang bzo'i chos lugs du ma yis/ /bstan pa'i nyams len sdom gsum la/ /gnad kyi don rnams bshigs nas ni/ /thos chung mgo skor mang du byung / /de dag lung dang rigs pa yis/ /rnam par bsal nas gnad rnams la/ /skal ldan ma 'khrul spyod pa'i phyir/ /bstan bcos chen po 'di byas so/ /phyogs zhen rab rib dang bral zhing / /rnam dpyod gsal ba'i mig ldan pas/ /tshul bzhin bltas na lam bzang gi /snang ba gsal bar 'gyur ro zhes/ /kho bos gsang mtho'i skad kyis sgrogs/ /ci phyir zhe na mdo rgyud kyi/ /gnad la blo gros dri med kyis/ /dpyad nas smras pa yin phyir ro/ /de slad snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru/ /skal ldan zab don don gnyer rnams/ /legs bshad 'di yis 'khrid byas nas/ /gsung rab grong khyer bgrod par rigs/ /bsod nams 'di yis tshogs gnyis ri bo'i rtser/ /spang rtogs nus pa'i lus stobs rab rgyas te/ /mtha' yas 'gro la srid pa'i mthar thug par/ /dam chos seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs par shog /gang sku 'jigs rung sprin sngon klong dkyil nas/ /zhal dmar rnam par g.yo ba'i klog phreng 'khyug /hūm̐ phaṭ 'brug gi 'ur chems sgrogs pa can/ /srung ma'i dbang pos legs bshad 'di spel cig /sdom pa gsum gyi rab ta dbye ba'i kha skong gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad 'od kyi snang ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/
